question: When can I register for 2027 Kindergarten?
expected: English registration begins in January; exact local dates unknown; French dates separately labelled for September 2027 entry.

result.question: When can I register for 2027 Kindergarten?
result.answer:
School year: 2027–28. English Kindergarten registration begins in January. The board directs families to their local school for exact dates and times; no school-specific deadline is verified here. For registration or a transfer during the selected school year, contact the school office. No school-specific closing date is verified in this directory. Early French Immersion applications for September 2027: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-27. Early French Immersion is a separate central application for Junior Kindergarten entry in September 2027. This window does not establish placement at either pilot school.

Dates depend on entry year and program. Only the September 2027 JK French Immersion window is verified here; dates for other entry years are not verified.

[Official registration guidance](https://www.tdsb.on.ca/EarlyYears/Kindergarten) · checked 2026-09-12.
